what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-0 by roll call to accept the BrightFarms TIF agreement (draft seven) and recommend the article to Special Town Meeting.
The vote commits the board to recommend the TIF article at the special town meeting the next evening.
The agreement ends at eight years or when the maximum exemption, defined as a dollar cap, is reached, whichever comes first.
BrightFarms pays full taxes on improvements as assessed until occupancy and completion; the TIF engages only at completion.
The job commitment in the agreement can fall to a floor and no lower.

why_it_matters: A TIF exempts part of a company's added property value from tax for a set period, so the cap and the eight-year limit set how much tax the town gives up on this project.
Town Meeting voters, not the board, decide whether the article passes, and the job floor and the full taxes during construction are the terms they can weigh.
